SnakeList logo: pick one

Two updates to the logo SnakeList has now. Both keep the snake S with its spots, the same greens and the rattlesnake tick. They make the snake a little bigger, give it a clearer head and eye, clean up the spots and give the tick more room. Everything below is a screenshot of the real site, the first row as it is today and then with each option.

  • Same snake S and spot pattern
  • Same green colours
  • Same rattlesnake tick (diamonds + rattle)
  • Same lettering

Option A: light touch

Closest to today

Same snake, same spots, same rattlesnake tick. The spots are cleaner and no longer blur into each other. The head is about 10% bigger, with a thin dark edge where it lies on the coil and a bigger eye with a tiny shine. The S is a little taller, and the tick has more room. In light mode the name is a shade deeper green.
